resources.string: Shown while your position is shared.
Your position is shared while your task is under way.
Informs you when you must sign in again.
Please sign in again to share your position
Your position is no longer shared. Open the application and sign in.

While your task is under way, this application collects your position about once a minute, even when the application is closed or not in use. The sharing stops when the task ends, when you sign out, and after six hours at most. A notification shows it the whole time.
